policies.label: No hardcoded credentials
policies.description: Load secrets from process.env or a secrets manager — never inline them.
policies.fix: Replace the inline value with process.env.YOUR_SECRET_NAME and add the key to .env.example.

policies.label: No custom cryptographic implementations
policies.description: Use jose@5 with RS256 for all JWT work. Do not implement crypto primitives by hand.
policies.fix: Replace the custom implementation with the jose library equivalent.

policies.label: Only packages already in package.json may be introduced
policies.description: Do not add new npm packages without explicit approval. Suggest existing alternatives.

policies.label: Tests required when modifying auth or payment logic
policies.description: Any change to authentication or payment code must include at least one new test.
